meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 给项目加上 Webex 渠道:复制 Webex 适配器、注册到渠道列表、安装固定版本的依赖,并配置机器人令牌与 Webhook 密钥。完成后,Webex 空间或私信里的消息能到达机器人,回复也能发回该空间。
howto.when: 当你说要添加、接入或启用 Webex 渠道,或在 /setup 流程里需要给项目加渠道时。

say.text: 帮我把 Webex 渠道加到项目里。
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: 接入 Webex,我要配置机器人令牌。
say.note: 会提示粘贴令牌和 Webhook 密钥。

say.text: 添加 Webex 后,帮我跑一遍注册测试。
say.note: 会构建并运行 webex 注册测试。

howto.what_en: Adds Webex support: copies the Webex adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned adapter package, and guides bot token/webhook secret setup. Webex space/DM messages then reach the bot, and replies go back to the space.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add, enable, or set up the Webex channel, or during a /setup flow when a channel needs adding.

say_en.text: Add the Webex channel to my project.
say_en.note: Copies, registers, and installs the adapter.

say_en.text: Set up Webex with a bot token.
say_en.note: Prompts for token and webhook secret.

say_en.text: After adding Webex, run the registration test.
say_en.note: Builds and runs the webex registration test.
